decisions.reason: A rye country bread fits the core craft assortment, uses existing production at low marginal cost, and with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations there is no trigger for problemistic search.
As the flagship premium stollen, the seasonal product central to the firm's gift and online business, it is very likely meeting aspirations and will be retained.
A seeded rye mixed bread is a standard bakery item that extends established recipes, and its results are acceptable enough to keep it on the routine assortment.
The dark malt rye is a somewhat more niche variant, but with low carrying costs and available slack the firm can tolerate uncertain demand rather than drop it.
Marzipan stollen is a classic German seasonal favorite that complements the flagship stollen in gift assortments, so it is likely to stay.
The ancient grain bread was promoted as the newest masterpiece, targets health-oriented demand, and was just launched, so the firm will keep it while it builds sales.
